notes.title: Version 0.6.0 Released！
notes.content:
Dear players,

It's been a while since the last update. We have received a lot of feedback from players around the world. Many of them featuring the same request: players feel like hindered by overwhelming minigames and eventually lost patience. Thus in this update we decide to rebalance most of the minigames and tries to smoothen the overall difficulty and gameplay experience, we also added the function to skip minigames you have already beat for those players who replay the game multiple times to get all the achivements.

Many thanks to all players who support The Shape of Heart along the way. It is not a profitable project for us, and we are working on it based on our beliefs. To keep our team running, we are currently developing another new title. So future updates for The Shape of Heart might be slower than before. 

However, the Third Episode of The Shape of Heart "CONSTRAINT" will be released within 2018, as well as the release of our new game, Circle Of Life. :D

notes.title: Episode Two Finally Online!
notes.content:
[h1]Episode Two Finally Online![/h1]

The Shape of Heart now supports 7 languages. Starting from in Episode Two, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and French are added to the game!
In addition to a brand new episode, we have made some improvements to the game too, such as:
 [*]Improved interaction experience in certain scenes. 
 [*]Applied shortcut keys for certain items
 [*]Added Episode Mode for players who have completed an Episode and needs to play it again.
 [*] Improved liquid flow and sound effort details.
 [*]Resolved some known bugs in previous versions.

If you encounter any difficulty when playing the game, please submit your feedback in the Community Discussions. Thank you!

notes.title: Episode 2 Is Coming!
notes.content:
After the Early Access version is released on Steam, we have received many feedbacks from our players. We are more than happy to see that you approve our ideas and like our game, and we are trying our best to develop a new episode. We draw lessons from mistakes we made previously, and add more contents to Episode 2. The little boy is growing. You need to help him endure the growing pains, and make tough choices that may change the course of his life.

[b]Friendly Reminder: Certain sideline plots in Episode 2 is related to the choices you made in the Episode 1. /b]

Episode 2 is coming soon!

notes.title: V0.4.10 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]This update includes:[/h1]

* Added difficulty selection for the mini games, while players can still challenge for hard difficulties to unlock relevant achievements.
* Revised an issue about memory leak. We won’t occupy your precious memory space any more.
* Revised an issue that mini games do not response and UI gets overlapped.

notes.title: 0.4.9 Update is live
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you all for supporting The Shape of Heart! We have received many feedbacks and advices from our players. This update includes:[/h1]
* Revised an issue that texts are incorrectly displayed in game.
* Revised an issue that texts are missing in certain languages that the game does not support.
* Revised an issue that Plumber Bros the mini game does not response when in-game language is changed.
* Added a function that players can see a “Saving” indicator on the top-right corner.
* Revised an issue that Loading is missing in the Lowered the difficulty of Blocks the mini game, but players can still choose to challenge the hard mode.
* Optimized visual effect of the game.
* Optimized audio effect of the game.


[h1]We will continue to update and improve the game quality. The next update will include:[/h1]
* Revise an issue that the mouse cursor is incorrectly displayed when multiple monitors are used.
* Add difficulty selection for the mini games, and optimize the game curve.
* Revise an issue that the game gets lagging when saving.
* Revise some issues about memory leak and improve game performance.

notes.title: A Gamer’s doodle diary ------ The Shape of Heart
notes.content:
ːangelheartːThe Shape of Heart is a [b]new game[/b] that bears a [b]new gene[/b]. What we are trying to deliver, is the stories that most gamers have already experienced or been experiencing in their lives. We hope to use this game to wake up those memory fragments the in your heart and join them together again. Rethink about your past, present, and future, and bring back those [b]passionate[/b] and [b]exciting[/b] days! If you could find an echo in this game, we developers will be truly happy.

What’s your Shape of Heart?
